result.title: Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping
result.comment: To appear at BMVC 2026. Code available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL
result.summary: Voxel-based volumetric mapping is fundamental to 3D reconstruction, yet fixed-resolution grids remain inherently inefficient - wasting memory in uniform regions and losing detail in complex ones. Existing adaptive methods, such as MAP-ADAPT, partially address this by varying resolution based on geometry and user-defined semantic class lists, but these heuristics require expert tuning, lack generalization to unseen objects, and provide no explicit mechanism to control memory usage. We propose an adaptive framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, which captures label uncertainty, together with geometric curvature and texture richness as scene complexity cues, yielding principled resolution allocation without reliance on semantic taxonomies. To make the accuracy-memory trade-off explicit and user-controlled, we further introduce a reinforcement learning agent that learns voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified target memory budget, replacing hand-tuned thresholds with a single intuitive control parameter. The resulting multi-resolution TSDF achieves higher geometric accuracy, better semantic consistency, and improved memory-accuracy trade-offs compared to MAP-ADAPT and fixed-resolution baselines on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出基于语义熵、几何曲率和纹理丰富度等场景复杂度线索自适应细分体素的 3D 建图框架，并用 RL 智能体在用户指定内存预算下学习体素细分策略，以替代手工阈值，在合成与真实数据集上改善精度—内存权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语义熵 + 复杂度线索驱动、RL 在资源预算下决定细分/停止」的机制，可能与 LVR 中何时获取视觉证据、动态分配计算与停止决策、以及按不确定性和信息价值筛选视觉细节的问题形成概念类比，可供核查。
